sql: select market_ticker, side, action, limit_price, quantity, status, cancel_reason, created_at::text, left(client_order_id,12) coid, (select string_agg(at::text || chr(32) || residual_cents, chr(124)) from incentive_balance_observations where at > timestamp '2026-10-11 11:00' and residual_cents > 99) credits from live_orders where strategy='Alimm1' and (created_at > '2026-10-13 09:30' or status in ('resting','partial','pending','submitted')) order by created_at desc limit 20
